about: What's new (issue #63): notes the recordings get when showcase.py build makes a .cast from rec/*.tsv. The real output is never changed: a note is a new yellow '# ...' line before the line it explains. notes: the first rule whose 'match' (a regex) finds the line wins; 'after' (a regex) must have matched an earlier line of the same screen; no note when one was added in the last 'window' lines. collapse: a run of more than 'min' consecutive lines that match is kept to its first 'keep' lines plus one line 'say' ({n}: how many were left out).
